description: Exa-only probe: five Monitors on direct competitors' pricing and changelog pages, run daily for two weeks (2026-09-26 to 2026-10-10). Question: does a monitor surface real pricing or product changes within the KB's 30-day staleness window for competitive leaves? Results are polled through the API. The webhook subscribes only to monitor.deleted and points at a non-existent path on Exa's own site (owner's choice of a placeholder, 2026-09-26; Exa rejected example.com), so no results are delivered anywhere.

monitors.name: provider-eval SM m01 Tavily
monitors.query: Tavily API pricing, credits, plans, or changelog update

monitors.name: provider-eval SM m02 Parallel
monitors.query: Parallel Web Systems API pricing, processors, or changelog update

monitors.name: provider-eval SM m03 Firecrawl
monitors.query: Firecrawl pricing, credits, plans, or changelog update

monitors.name: provider-eval SM m04 Perplexity API
monitors.query: Perplexity API pricing, Search API, or API changelog update

monitors.name: provider-eval SM m05 Brave Search API
monitors.query: Brave Search API pricing, plans, or changelog update

grading: At the end, each result is judged: a real, dated pricing or product change on the competitor's own page (yes/no), and whether the KB leaf already has it. Metric: real changes surfaced per monitor, and how many landed inside the 30-day staleness window.
